claim: EJMI sufficient rule or narrow observations may miss other impairment
observed_result: 8/8 historical candidate-window rows fail aggregate EJMI; all 12 runs have zero M technical stopped samples, but local FCD speed distributions differ across regions.
alternative_or_limit: EJMI negativity is preserved; slow samples alone are not approved impairment. FCD and E1 speeds have different weighting and populations.
next_discriminating_action: Define intended M estimand and an eligible reference before new validation; do not relabel old EJMI.

claim: Actual near-merge insertion limits traveled upstream observation domain
observed_result: All 16622 M actual entries are 0.10-286.75m from main_up end, despite 1394.87m named upstream lane.
alternative_or_limit: This confirms limited realized feeder travel, not that extending geometry or changing insertion will solve Q2/Q4.
next_discriminating_action: Priority candidate: specify intended actual entry/observation domain; compare one registered insertion/observation intervention only if scientifically selected.

claim: Merge priority or lane-changing restrictions may limit R admission
observed_result: R first-downstream counts and upstream expansion are observed; static priority evidence is supplied by engineering.
alternative_or_limit: No raw lane-change/gap-acceptance log; FCD does not establish causal behavioral rule or accepted-gap distribution.
next_discriminating_action: Use static engineering findings and entry-domain diagnosis to select one discriminating contrast; do not tune multiple behavior rules.

claim: Downstream supply or exit boundary may dominate observations
observed_result: No M <=0.1m/s sample anywhere on its observed route in any of 12 complete trajectories; downstream records and arrivals remain available.
alternative_or_limit: This weakens a stopped-M queue-at-exit explanation only. Non-stopped speed restriction and detailed downstream effects are not excluded.
next_discriminating_action: Retain downstream as a check in a selected candidate; do not prioritize boundary redesign solely from current data.

claim: Finite loading and delayed entry affect demand-window interpretation
observed_result: All 12 runs retain R/U entry after1500s; R late entry9-181 and U9-90 vehicles per run; final arrivals1859-2558s.
alternative_or_limit: Post is not zero-inflow recovery; successful full clearance does not justify1500s demand duration or warm-up.
next_discriminating_action: Any new candidate must register symmetric finite horizons considering changed travel time and delayed entry, not copy old sufficiency.

claim: TLS and shared urban queue context confound U exposure interpretation
observed_result: All 12 runs have R/U shared stopped labels under green, red and yellow movement0 contexts.
alternative_or_limit: Green-labeled shared stopping does not isolate ramp-caused delay; TLS is upstream, with unverified within-step ordering.
next_discriminating_action: Preserve movement-specific TLS and U outcomes; no causal U-loss gate or signal retiming is justified by cooccurrence alone.
